assumptions: All parameters participant-set (opening hours, opening days, simultaneous posts, effective hours per FTE, shift-coverage factor); no named operator exists.

p0_rom_cost_low_million_cny.formula: sum(five participant-set line items, low) * 1.35 contingency

p0_rom_cost_high_million_cny.formula: sum(five participant-set line items, high) * 1.35 contingency, rounded from 4.2525

group_specific_acceptance_coverage.formula: count(scenarios with group-specific criteria) / count(applicable scenarios) = 5/5 (scenarios 03, 04, 06, 09, 12)

p0_cost_public_anchor_count.formula: count of public numeric cost anchors registered for the P0 demonstrator (retrofit band lower and upper, barrier-free package magnitude, soil-sensor unit price, property OPEX upper bound); the Beijing cost-information publication channel is registered separately as a mechanism, not a numeric anchor
assumptions: Anchors are other projects' published procurement calibers, registered in sources.json; none is a quotation for this site.
